messages:
mina: quick note — nikita15b (int4) canary started showing OOMs under mixed short+very-long generation traffic. rolling back the canary for now.
todd: ouch. any logs to paste?
mina: log snippet:
```
2026-04-10T02:14:08Z WARN  kv_cache: allocated +16 slots (480 -> 496)
2026-04-10T02:14:08Z ERROR oom: alloc failed attention_kv size=1100000000
2026-04-10T02:14:08Z INFO  serving: req=abc123 gen_tokens=1700 route=nikita15b-int4
```
eva: 1700 tokens + prefetch=2 + default batch=3 is predictable trouble on int4. slot growth blows up.
sam: how did it look on throughput/latency vs fp16?
mina: p50 up slightly from 130ms -> 160ms, p95 up from 520ms -> 980ms during long-gen flood. throughput down ~22%. quality (qa/f1) within noise for most prompts but a small cluster of long-code docs had token mismatches ~1.2%.
leah: propose immediate canary defaults change (safety-first):
```
routes:
  - model: nikita15b-int4
    defaults:
      max_new_tokens: 400
      batch_size: 2
      prefetch_window: 1
    runtime:
      soft_evict: true
      kv_trim_threshold: 0.8
      compactor_interval_s: 300
```
mina: also add a dynamic microbatching rule: if requested_gen_tokens >= 512 then force batch_size<=2 for that request. helps avoid packing many long gens together.
todd: agree. add routing fallback: if requested_gen_tokens > 1024 route to nikita15b-int8. safe short-term.
eva: diagnostics to collect during next canary: nvml snapshots every 30s, jemalloc stats, slot-usage heatmap, and kernel alloc trace. add flags: `--nvml-snap --jemalloc --slot-hist --alloc-trace` to smoke runner.
sam: smoke plan: run 90m with 300 randomized long-gen replays and 200 mixed-length conversations; gating rules: no OOMs, p95 within 30% of fp16 baseline, quality delta <0.5% on the long-doc set.
mina: ops-bot: queue deploy with the route patch and smoke flags.
ops-bot: deploybot: canary deploy queued by mina — job #4522 started :hourglass:
leah: further safety: implement a temporary per-pod kv_slot_cap of 640 for the canary pool to avoid unbounded slot growth while we tune compactor.
todd: for perf-first experiments later, we can test adaptive_prefetch: reduce prefetch_window when free_slot_ratio < 0.25 and gradually increase when stable. but don't run that in initial canary.
eva: small quality note — we saw token-mismatch spikes around nested markdown/code contexts. include 30 targeted prompts in smoke eval and fail if any >2% token mismatch.
sam: add nvml diff snapshots at 0/30/60/90m and slot-hist timeseries to the artifacts. will correlate fragmentation to p95 spikes.
mina: infra follow-ups: ask infra to confirm compactor runs reliably on that pool; in one prior run compactor was disabled on one node and fragmentation spiked.
leah: if the canary still produces OOMs after conservative defaults + slot cap, fallback to: 1) serve int8 for requests >=700 tokens, 2) enable immediate soft_kv_evict on allocations failure, 3) temporarily lower compactor_interval_s to 120s.
todd: once smoke passes, ramp plan: 5% traffic for 2h with slowstart (0.5x every 20m), keep compactor_interval=180s, capture nvml snapshots at each ramp point.
eva: long-term tickets: (A) kernel allocation coalescing to reduce fragmentation, (B) slot reuse heuristics to prefer reuse over growth, (C) pre-onboard gate that rejects int4 routes with prefetch>1 or max_new_tokens>512. open those after canary.
sam: i'll prepare the PR with route patch, microbatch rule, slot cap, and smoke runner flags. linking dashboards and baseline artifacts in the PR.
mina: thanks — i'll hold rollback until job #4522 finishes and we'll review artifacts. auto-rollback rule: >2 OOMs in 60m or quality delta breach.
ops-bot: deploybot: job #4522 running. artifacts will be posted to /artifacts/nikita15b/4522.tar.gz when complete.
leah: small ops tip: add `--nvml-snapshot-per-pod` so we can map NVML snapshots to pod IDs; it'll make correlation much simpler.
eva: agreed. also capture `--gpu-page-faults` if available.
todd: once stable, update onboarding doc: "int4 onboarding: require long-context smoke, slot-hist, nvml snapshots, conservative defaults, and fallback route to int8."
mina: perfect. will follow-up with results. thanks all :thumbsup:
